buildProposal.decision: Implement the bounded C3 one-account trust loop: exact contradiction resolution and restoration, attention across statement edits, immutable history and as-saved snapshots, explicit refresh and Save, account search and return to brief, constrained operator-trial version labeling, and prospective capacity reservations that preserve restoration.
buildProposal.scope: Build permission under the adopted standing development policy for the existing C3 source/test/runbook candidate and its sanitized verification record. Resolve selected existing contradictions against the exact current proposition with attributed reason and factual basis; restore one exact active contradiction/resolution pair without changing other conflicts. Statement edits expire prior judgments and retain prior-scope conflict attention and immutable history; no-change preserves state. Legacy saved snapshots retain their as-saved labels and hashes, with current review shown separately and explicit Refresh working snapshot then Save required for a new saved version. Account-local literal search preserves review reasoning; Return to brief and Save resumes the existing account-qualified draft. Optional isolated operator-trial labeling carries a constrained configured build SHA and retained-evidence/generation-off/acquisition-off mode, not runtime attestation or authority. Prospective reservations preserve each active target restoration across per-item history, shared-root publication and serialized-byte caps; they do not enlarge quotas, migrate originals or guarantee physical storage availability. Includes relevant offline checks, independent technical review, parent-verified isolated-copy evidence, and ordinary exact-head PR/review/CI/merge under existing authority; meaningful technical gates remain unchanged. Implementation permission is separate from product effects. Code landing authorizes no new acquisition, paid product generation, external sends, production deployment or public ingress, historical original mutation, closed-v8 retries, refused-attempt imports, new private-data access, multiuser access, factual confirmation or customer acceptance. Existing authorized isolated-copy preview and recovery evidence confer no new product authority; recovery is external parent evidence, not a newly shipped backup utility or production recovery guarantee. Existing scope, budgets, successful-record admission, raw-response identity, persistence and product-effect permissions remain unchanged. This proposal is not ratification or human approval; customer acceptance remains pending Andrew judgment.
